questions.stem: Which of the following is a key pathological feature of myasthenia gravis?

options.label: A
options.text: Neuronal loss in the spinal cord

questions.solutionHtml:
Neuromuscular junction destruction
  • Myasthenia gravis is an autoimmune disorder in which antibodies attack the acetylcholine receptors (AChR) at the neuromuscular junction, leading to their destruction and impaired neuromuscular transmission.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 1236
